verdict.rationale: The official GitHub README pitches the open-source Python library as letting you automate the web "with any LLM" (browser-use-gh-3). A community user corroborates broad model compatibility from running it with a Gemini model (browser-use-comm-1). That establishes the model-agnostic, bring-your-own-provider core, at least for the local library. missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs listing supported providers and how to configure them, clarity on whether the Cloud Agent API also allows bring-your-own models.
